messages:
Nora Kim: ACME wants hard timelines for POC: 24h ack, 48h confirmed notice, CAIQ answers in 3bd, and named IR POC. Can we give that?

Caleb Torres: Ops note 1: we can ACK suspected incidents within 24h. Confirmed breach notification usually sits at 72h after confirmation. 48h is risky unless legal agrees.

Anya Ivanov: Legal agrees to 24h ack + 72h confirmed. Suggested SOW snippet:
```
"Provider will acknowledge suspected security incidents affecting Customer within 24 hours of detection and will notify Customer of a confirmed data breach within 72 hours of confirmation. Provider will provide an initial incident summary and use commercially reasonable efforts to deliver a final report typically within 21 days."
```

Caleb Torres: Artifacts we can provide: access logs, timeline, hashes/IOCs, redacted forensic artifacts. No raw PII. Ops can attach a standard artifact list.

Nora Kim: CAIQ: we can commit prefilled CAIQ in 3 business days for standard sets. Full SIG/custom answers 10+ bd. I'll tell them that.

ops-bot: IR playbook v2  https://redwood.internal/playbooks/ir-v2 (internal)

legal-bot: Add embargo clause: "Provider and Customer will coordinate public communications and will not disclose incident details without mutual agreement except as required by law." Legal will lead regulatory notices.

Anya Ivanov: Proposed contact block for SOW: IR inbox: ir@redwood.com; IR lead (POC): caleb@redwood.com; Pager: +1-555-IR-425. Include CAIQ prefill link and a one-pager SIG scope.

Nora Kim: Thanks. I'll send the SOW language and CAIQ commitment back to ACME now and loop when they reply.
